findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the upper nozzles above the ground baskets on the coffee maker to have an accumulation of soils. Discussed with PIC. Ensure these nozzles are cleaned frequently enough to keep them clean to sight and touch. Inspector will return 03/21/2025 to follow-up on violation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a build up of ice along the sides of the ice cream chest freezer next to the counter of the establishment. Discussed with PIC, and PIC stated that they defrost the machine regularly. Inspector recommends increasing the frequency of scheduled defrosting. Ensure the machine is defrosted regularly enough to render the inside surfaces smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Microwave (community use) is soiled w/ food debris- clean as often as necessary to prevent soil accumulation. Will check next routine inspection. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Handwashing sink located in back storage room is blocked by cleaner bottles. Ensure handwashing sinks are accessible at all times. Dicsussed with PIC. Handling of customer beverage containers, straws, etc. Handsinks should be accessible. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.
